messages:
brad_partnerships: Quick sync — we need to finalize the catalog taxonomy and trial SKU mapping for AWS/GCP/Azure. We're blocked on legal naming + trial duration flags. Can we triage?

anya_sales: Do we have a recommended default trial? Sales prefers 14-day with 10k token credit. Any objections?

kevin_legal: 14-day OK, but need standard TOS clause and telemetry opt-in wording for marketplace trials. I'll drop proposed text.

zoe_product: Packaging note — we should expose two SKUs: 'Starter (trial)' and 'Pay-as-you-go'. Starter should include API key + 10k token credit. Also, need to decide whether trial is auto-convert or opt-in conversion email.

sam_devex: On the ops side: Marketplace listing needs SKU IDs and JSON manifest. I'll upload a draft manifest here: 
```json
{
  "sku_map": [
    {"market": "aws", "sku": "RW-INF-STARTER-TRIAL", "duration_days": "14"},
    {"market": "gcp", "sku": "rw-infer-trial-14", "duration_days": "14"},
    {"market": "azure", "sku": "RW-TRIAL-14-AZ", "duration_days": "14"}
  ]
}
```
Can legal confirm naming?

kevin_legal: Names look fine but lowercase vs uppercase matters in publisher portal. I'll standardize. Also need allowed data-processing note: 'metadata and usage telemetry for quality and billing'. I'll paste clause.

anya_sales: Also want trial funnel telemetry — we need events: trial_started, quota_consumed_50pct, trial_expired_no_convert. Product: can you wire events to marketplace referral_id?

zoe_product: Yep. We'll add referral_id to initial token grant. Sam, add docs for telemetry endpoints.

sam_devex: I will. Also note: AWS requires license terms PDF and trial EULA link. Can someone point me to latest EULA?

brad_partnerships: @kevin_legal can you attach EULA link? @anya_sales please confirm default credit cap and whether we allow billing auto-upgrade.

kevin_legal: Attached: https://redwood.internal/legal/marketplace_trial_eula_v3.pdf. Auto-upgrade needs explicit consent; we'll default to opt-in email.

anya_sales: Confirmed: 10k token credit, opt-in auto-upgrade. We'll A/B test a 7-day vs 14-day window later.

brad_partnerships: Ok next steps: Kevin to push EULA + naming by EOD, Sam to drop manifest + publishable artifact, Zoe to update product page copy, Anya to prepare trial comms playbook. Check-ins tomorrow 10am PST. :thumbsup: 

deploy-bot: Reminder: marketplace manifest upload scheduled for 2024-02-15T18:00Z. Reply 'ack' to confirm.

sam_devex: ack
